topics.name: Personal Pronouns & Deictic Reference
topics.description: Pronominal paradigm distinguishing first (ei), second familiar (nang) vs honorific (nahak), and third person (mahak), including case suffixation and discourse roles.
topics.documentation: Directly attested in Pettigrew 1912 (p. 14) and Grierson 1904 LSI Vol. III Part III (p. 19, 54).

topics.name: Numerals & Counting System
topics.description: Morphology of decimal roots 1–5 with prefixation (vocalic a- on roots 1–3, nasal ma- on roots 4–5), decade formation, and compounding.
topics.documentation: Attested in Grierson 1904 (p. 54 numeral table) and Pettigrew 1912 (p. 25).

topics.name: Verbal & Indicative Negation
topics.description: Morphological suffixation of negative marker -te / -de directly onto verb stems, intervocalic voicing rules, and contrast with prohibitive imperative forms.
topics.documentation: Analyzed in Chelliah 1997 A Grammar of Meithei (pp. 260–264) and Pettigrew 1912 (pp. 38–40).

topics.name: Verb Morphology & Aspect Suffixes
topics.description: Agglutinative suffix chain attaching aspectual markers (progressive -li/-ri, perfective -le/-re) and modal formatives to verbal roots.

topics.name: Sentence Structure & Syntax
topics.description: Canonical Subject-Object-Verb (SOV) head-final word order, postpositional phrase structure, agentive/nominative marking (-na), and topic-comment organization.

topics.name: Numeral Classifiers
topics.description: System of sortal and mensural numeral classifiers (e.g. animacy, shape, roundness, container classifiers) qualifying countable nouns.
topics.unpopulated_reason: Recognized linguistic category (Chelliah 1997, pp. 105–115). Specific verified manuscript/fieldwork citations pending formal philological ingestion.

topics.name: Noun Morphology & Case Postpositions
topics.description: Nominal inflection, case-marking postpositions (-na, -bu, -gi, -da, -tagi), gender formative affixes (-pa/-pi), and collective pluralizers.
topics.unpopulated_reason: Recognized research category (Chelliah 1997, pp. 95–130). Category registered; specific lexical-morphological entries pending peer-reviewed verification.

topics.name: Discourse & Evidential Particles
topics.description: Information-packaging enclitics, focus markers (-su, -di), interrogative morphemes, and evidential suffixes.
topics.unpopulated_reason: Recognized research category. Individual textual attestations and folios pending systematic verification against primary corpora.
